source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the unnumbered Spin Quantum Number topic, printed page 32, with Quick Check 2.3 and answers.

blocks.text: Electron ko apne axis (dhuri) ke gird ghoomta hua samjha jata hai, jaise zameen ghoomti hai. Electromagnetic theory ke mutabiq ghoomta hua charge magnetic field banata hai, is liye ghoomta electron ek chhote magnet ki tarah behave karta hai. Electron do tarah ghoom sakta hai: clockwise (ghari ki suiyon ki taraf) aur anticlockwise (ulti taraf). Spin ko shamil karne ke liye chautha quantum number lagaya gaya: electron spin quantum number (s). Is ki do qeematein hain: +½ aur −½.

blocks.alt: Do ghoomte electrons golon ki shakal mein, har ek ke gird gol arrow aur neeche bar magnet: (a) clockwise spin, magnet mein N oopar S neeche, oopar wala arrow, s = +1/2; (b) counterclockwise spin, S oopar N neeche, neeche wala arrow, s = -1/2.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.4: Electron ka (a) clockwise (b) counterclockwise spin (kitab ki figure ke mutabiq original drawing; kitab mein doosri baar Figure 2.4 chhapa hai, text ise Figure 2.8 kehta hai).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure mein (a) clockwise ke neeche neeche wala arrow aur (b) ke neeche oopar wala arrow chhapa hai, jo kitab ke apne text aur Table 2.6 ke khilaf hai. Sahi: clockwise = s = +½ = oopar wala arrow (↑); anticlockwise = s = −½ = neeche wala arrow (↓). Upar ki drawing sahi hai.

Clockwise spin ko oopar ki taraf wale arrow (teer) ↑ se aur anticlockwise spin ko neeche ki taraf wale arrow ↓ se dikhate hain. Ek orbital mein zyada se zyada do electrons aa sakte hain, condition (shart) yeh hai ke dono ke spins opposite (ulte) hon.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke clockwise spin arrow (↓) se ‘upwards’ aur phir dobara ‘clockwise’ spin arrow (↑) se ‘downwards’ dikhaya jata hai. Arrows ulte chhape hain aur doosra spin anticlockwise hona chahiye. Sahi: clockwise (+½) = ↑, anticlockwise (−½) = ↓.
Yani orbital ko batane ke liye teen quantum numbers (n, ℓ, m) kaafi hain, magar us orbital ke do electrons mein farq karne ke liye chautha (s) chahiye.

blocks.title: Did you Know? (kya aap jaante hain?)
blocks.text: n wale shell mein n subshells, n² orbitals aur zyada se zyada 2n² electrons hote hain. Maslan n = 3: 3 subshells (3s, 3p, 3d), 9 orbitals, 18 electrons.

blocks.prompt: Helium ke 1s orbital mein do electrons hain. Dono ke chaar quantum numbers likhein aur batayein kya alag hai.
blocks.explanation: Dono ke n = 1, ℓ = 0, m = 0 hain kyun ke dono ek hi orbital mein hain. Farq sirf spin ka hai: ek ka s = +½ aur doosre ka s = −½.

blocks.prompt: a) Har quantum number electron ke bare mein kya batata hai: (i) principal (ii) azimuthal (iii) magnetic (iv) spin?
blocks.explanation: (i) n: shell, aur orbital ka size aur energy. (ii) ℓ: subshell aur orbital ki shape. (iii) m: orbital ka space mein orientation (rukh). (iv) s: electron ka spin, +½ (↑) ya −½ (↓). Pehle teen orbital batate hain, chautha electron.

blocks.prompt: b) (i) n = 2 aur ℓ = 1 ho to space mein kitne orientations mumkin hain? (ii) n = 3 aur ℓ = 2 ho to electron kis shell aur subshell ka hai? (iii) ℓ = 2 ho to m ki sab qeematein aur har m ke liye zyada se zyada electrons?
blocks.explanation: (i) Yeh 2p subshell hai; m = −1, 0, +1, yani 3 orientations. (ii) n = 3 = M shell, ℓ = 2 = d subshell: 3d. (iii) m = −2, −1, 0, +1, +2; har m (orbital) mein zyada se zyada 2 electrons, yani poore d subshell mein 10.

items: Spin quantum number s = +½ (clockwise, ↑) ya −½ (anticlockwise, ↓); ghoomta electron magnet jaisa hai.
Orbital mein zyada se zyada 2 electrons, ulte spins ke saath; teen numbers orbital, chautha electron batata hai.
